Name: Gas hob with auto re-ignition
Description: A 60 cm four-burner gas hob on natural gas whose spark module re-ignites: it sparks while a knob is on until it senses that burner's flame, and stops by itself (GasHobSpec.FourBurnerReignition, docs/GAS_HOB.md), as on higher-end North American ranges. The interact key lights the next burner, or with every burner lit turns them all off. Place it on the worktop with its back (+Z) to the wall. Not a recording and not a loop.
